# lean-computer-use

> Keep native Mac app work in a small context, chain actions, and verify one filtered read.

Install: `npx lean-computer-use`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-computer-use/blob/main/README.md): Start here.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-computer-use/blob/main/docs/README.md): Choose a guide.
- [Install](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-computer-use/blob/main/docs/install.md): Install and remove the package.
- [Installer reference](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-computer-use/blob/main/docs/INSTALLER.md): Read options and file ownership.
- [Driver setup](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-computer-use/blob/main/docs/cua-driver-install.md): Prepare native app control.
- [Method](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-computer-use/blob/main/docs/METHOD.md): Follow the process.
- [Stack](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-computer-use/blob/main/docs/STACK.md): Read the stack card.

## Part of a set

- [agent-personalizer](https://github.com/aunysillyme/agent-personalizer): AI custom instructions from approved entries: a profile and rules for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and ChatGPT, kept in sync from one source.
- [model-orchestrator](https://github.com/aunysillyme/model-orchestrator): Model router for AI coding agents: routes routine work to cheaper models with routing rules, 8 subagents, hooks and a CLI runner
- [repo-build-skill](https://github.com/aunysillyme/repo-build-skill): Skill pack that teaches your AI to build, release and launch a GitHub repo: stack pick, README, AGENTS.md, llms.txt, repo SEO and AEO, trusted publishing.
- [website-build-skill](https://github.com/aunysillyme/website-build-skill): A skill pack that turns your AI into an expert website builder: current research, design, code, accessibility, speed, SEO and security, alone or as a team.
- [lean-browser-use](https://github.com/aunysillyme/lean-browser-use): The same method for web pages.
